dataset: Massachusetts municipal property tax billing schedules — statewide research (351 municipalities)
description: Massachusetts municipal property-tax billing research: 351 unique municipalities, 352 records including Manchester-by-the-Sea naming alias. Frequency verification is distinct from FY2027 due-date confirmation.
